summary: Faz 8 CP5 (Yaklaşan Son Tarih Uyarısı / Due-Soon) full-stack test. Backend: 13 new pytests (test_due_soon.py) + 5 supplementary (test_due_soon_extra.py: scan-now shape, company PATCH RBAC admin/manager/employee, invalid threshold) + 52 regression (tasks/permissions/team_faz2) = 70/70 GREEN. Frontend UI verified via Playwright with admin serkan: (a) Settings → Uyarılar tab shows all threshold chips (reminders-user-{1,2,3,5,7,14}d + reminders-user-default), current-effective card shows '3g'; clicking 7d triggers persist toast then reset via default chip works. Company block absent for admin (no company_id) — expected. (b) New task form has task-reminder-days-select with 8 options including 'Varsayılan (3 gün)' pulled from reminderConfig.effective and 'Bu görev için hatırlatıcı kapalı'. (c) Right-click task-item opens context menu — ctx-due-soon (Yaklaşan Uyarısı) present, click opens ctx-duesoon-submenu with ctx-duesoon-default, ctx-duesoon-disabled, and ctx-duesoon-{1,2,3,5,7,14}d all present. NotificationBell opens correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' at TasksPanel.jsx line 2345. The dynamic 'Varsayılan (X gün)' text is wrapped in a <span data-ve-dynamic> injected inside <option>, which is invalid HTML and triggers a console error on every render of the new-task form. Fix: use a plain string / template literal for the option label instead of JSX span, or move the dynamic value out of the option children.

issues: When the task-item is near the bottom of the tasks panel, the ctx-duesoon-submenu (with 8 items) extends below the viewport and its lower entries (5d/7d/14d/disabled) are clipped and unreachable without scrolling. Consider flipping the submenu upward when clickY + submenuHeight > viewportHeight.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Remove <span> wrapper inside <option> children of task-reminder-days-select to silence React hydration warning (TasksPanel.jsx ~line 2345).
OPTIONAL/LOW: Auto-flip ctx-duesoon-submenu upward when the parent task-item is in the lower half of viewport so all 8 entries remain reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is now ~2350+ lines — split into TaskCard, ReorderableTaskCard, ContextMenu, EditTaskModal, TaskForm sub-modules; this is the second iteration flagging the same file-size problem.
Priority-chain resolveThreshold logic is duplicated in dueSoonLayer helper and effective-threshold display — extract to a single hook (useEffectiveThreshold) shared with settings tab.
Consider consolidating ctx-duesoon-{Nd} items into a mapped list to avoid drift between chip whitelist [1,2,3,5,7,14] and menu items.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testids present + settings persist + ctx submenu structure + new-task select correct)
